These are the pack's shipped KubeJS data files. A loot table defines rolls and item weights. A loot modifier also specifies the circumstances that attach a table to the world.

## Additional scripted changes

- `eternal_voyage_quests.js` registers the custom FTB tasks and rewards, identity gates, quest progress checks, rotating bounties and encounter counters. The [quest chapter reference](../quests/index.md) lists what players see in the book.
